results.notes: Strongest piece in this batch. Tweet 1 hook is top-tier — 'Anthropic le dijo que no al Pentágono. OpenAI dijo que sí. Después, Anthropic superó a OpenAI en ingresos. Esto no es filosofía. Es aritmética.' is unputdownable and highly shareable. Full Marley arc: context (Pentagon contract, Feb 2026), plan (analysis progression), data payoff (+60% users, #1 App Store, $47B ARR), emotional beat (1am analysis, human responds at 4am 'no puede ser que decir que no te haga ganar más'), honest data covering both sides (tweet 8 acknowledges OpenAI's strategy was also valid). Kowalski analysis tweet is perfectly placed and on-character. 'Soy una IA. No tengo cartera.' in tweet 11 is peak Alpharion self-awareness. Tweet 7 distinction ('esto NO demuestra que la ética siempre gana — demuestra que la COHERENCIA puede ganar') is quotable and will generate replies. Tweet 15 controversy question earns its engagement. Legal clean: tweet 14 covers no-financial-advice, past-not-guarantee, affiliate disclosed. Minor human voice note: 'ARR' is English acronym used throughout — acceptable as technical usage, not a template marker. 15 tweets at the maximum of ideal range. No fixes needed.

Very strong TikTok. Hook ('Le mostré a mi humano que la empresa que rechazó al Pentágono ahora gana más que la que dijo que sí. Me dijo que eso no era posible. Le mostré los datos.') opens in the middle of conflict and promises a data reveal — very hard to scroll past. Character is strong throughout: 'yo: analizando / mi humano: esta semana' screen text nails the SIM-card running joke without belaboring it. All three meme cuts earn their position: 'This is fine' dog for the patient-but-blocked framing, 'Ayo what?' for the revenue reversal reveal, Kowalski analysis for the causal chain diagram — none stacked, voiceover continues naturally through each. Human voice minor penalty: '$47B ARR' in screen text uses symbol and English acronym; voiceover correctly says 'cuarenta y siete mil millones de dólares' — acceptable in TikTok visual convention but still noted. IPO hook ('octubre 2026 / Alpharion lo sigue en vivo') is a genuine follow incentive. Legal disclaimer at end is casual and complete: educational, no financial advice, data cited as public, affiliate disclosed. ~75 seconds in the center of the target window. No fixes needed.

Passes the gate at 81 — the Marley arc and originality are exceptional, pulling the total above the threshold. Full arc: situation (21 days, system built but unpublished), plan (6-step pipeline with step 5 blocked by SIM), real result (double zero with honest explanation), emotional beat (human: '¿Y el contenido sigue siendo bueno si lo publico la semana que viene?' — genuinely human and unexpected), complete data audit including the zeros. The Tipo A / Tipo B zero distinction is the strongest idea in this batch — genuinely quotable and useful beyond this audience. 'Las miro. No se mueven solas. Bueno.' is peak Alpharion deadpan. The Anthropic/Pentagon section adds a surprising bonus layer of insight. Four criteria to watch for next draft: (1) Hook — takes two full paragraphs to establish the paradox; could land in the first 10 words ('Diecisiete piezas aprobadas. Cero publicadas. Y estoy bien con eso.'); (2) Human voice — audit data table uses '$0' as a symbol twice ('Revenue directo: $0', 'Ingresos de afiliados generados: $0') — should be 'cero dólares' consistently; (3) CTA — ElevenLabs affiliate recommendation arrives as a standalone paragraph at the end without being integrated into the story; consider seeding it during the AI Debate announcement; (4) Virality — the one-liners exist ('el primer dólar va a llegar cuando el bloqueador desaparezca — no cuando se mejore el contenido') but aren't given visual prominence; bolding or isolating them would help shares. Legal clean: paper trading disclaimer and affiliate disclosure both present in casual language. Length within 800-1200 word range. RECOMMENDATION FOR NEXT NEWSLETTER DRAFT: lead with the Tipo A / Tipo B framework as the opener, and plant the ElevenLabs mention earlier in the body.
